cases.name: Cheyanne Lily Renee McClendon
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Cheyanne was a free spirit that loved life and never met a stranger. She would steal your heart with her bubbly personality and beautiful smile. Cheyanne was baptized at the age of 11 and recommitted her life to Christ and re-baptized at the age of 23. She was a child of God and knew and believed in her Heavenly Father, her Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, and the Holy Spirit. She didn't always walk the straight and narrow paths of life, but she never stopped believing and having faith in God. Cheyanne had four children, three sons and one daughter, that she loved and adored. She loved her children so much and wanted to give them a better life than what she had, a life that she knew in her heart that she could not provide for them. Cheyanne provided them an opportunity for a better life. As hard as it was for her she did the most admirable thing any person in her situation could do, let her children be adopted, allowing them to be God's blessings to others. She continued to carry a love for her children in her heart. She never stopped thinking about them, having concern for them, and praying for them. Cheyanne will be missed, but she will live on in our memories, our hearts, and through the lives of many she befriended in her short time here on earth. Cheyanne can rest now. She can enjoy the peace she longed for in the arms of Jesus. Our Heavenly Father promises we will all be reunited one day in His Heavenly home. This is not a good-bye to Cheyanne but a we will see you again Cheyanne."
cases.narrative: On 1/31/2021, she was found deceased in a wooded area on Gurden Avenue.
